profile.name: EMCO/ETS 2090 位置控制器
profile.description: 这是一种用于电磁兼容与天线测试系统的位置控制器，用于控制位置器或扫描机构的运动、目标位置、行程上下限以及垂直/水平极化切换。它常见于电波暗室或自动化测试平台中，用来驱动天线塔、扫描装置或类似运动平台完成定位与扫动。
profile.description_en: This is a positioner controller used in EMC and antenna test systems to control motion, target position, travel limits, and vertical/horizontal polarization selection. It is commonly used in anechoic chambers or automated test setups to drive antenna masts, scanning mechanisms, or similar motion platforms for positioning and sweeps.

registry.name: ETS-Lindgren ETS2090
registry.description: Ets2090是ETS-Lindgren提供的设备驱动，提供moving, device_type, limit_upper, limit_upper等16个控制接口。
